scope: Prospective limited forecast policy for Other, corporate and consolidation bridge, fixed before integrated cash results; not a stock valuation.
locator: Note 2, printed pages 10–11; Note 3 ownership; Note 6 restructuring
judgments: Use the latest quarter and nine-month recurring expense scales. Do not annualize the 2026 asset-impairment charge into every future year, and do not assume restructuring cash cost permanently vanishes.

SBC grows with staffing and compensation pressure. It is an economic operating expense charged once in consolidated EBIT; a cash-flow presentation must not restore its CFO addback without an offset for replacement compensation or dilution.
Other corporate cash costs increase modestly, rather than assuming all product growth converts to segment-level profit without central costs.

The 0.25B acquisition-related allowance is modeled as existing-intangible amortization and belongs within the consolidated D&A addback, not an additional addback on top of total D&A. It is a simplifying analytical classification, not a reported future schedule.

All Other revenue/profit is held around its 2026 run rate; no incremental autonomous-driving or divestment payoff is required for this case. This is a bounded neutral convention, not an independent Mobileye or IMS valuation.

Forward intersegment operating eliminations are normalized to zero. Foundry improvement cannot rely on repeating reserve releases or transferring profit between segments. Inventory growth cash is separately modeled in working capital; adverse reserve changes remain a risk rather than an invented annual observed amount.

Other-segment minority ownership remains in the cash/claims bridge; do not subtract it here and again later. Corporate operating expenses exclude interest, investment gains and income taxes, which belong below EBIT.
limitations: No future acquisition or divestiture is assumed.
Expense policy is analyst judgment, not management guidance.
Any material nonrecurring restructuring or inventory reserve event changes the reported earnings bridge and may change cash taxes; this finite forecast is not a complete scenario valuation.
